definitions.explanation: A number that is divisible by 2 with no remainder (2, 4, 6, 8, etc.).

examples.english: Garbage can only be put out on even-numbered days.

examples.japanese: {偶数|ぐうすう}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{奇数|きすう}→奇数：09634_kisuu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{判定|はんてい}する→判定：09767_hantei⟧⟦プログラム→プログラム：01540_puroguramu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I wrote a program to determine if a number is even or odd.

notes:
{偶数|ぐうすう} is a mathematical term for even numbers.

Opposite:
- {奇数|きすう} (odd number)

Mathematical terms:
- {整数|せいすう} (integer)
- {自然数|しぜんすう} (natural number)
- {小数|しょうすう} (decimal)
- {分数|ぶんすう} (fraction)
- {素数|そすう} (prime number)

Practical usage:
- {偶数|ぐうすう}{月|づき} (even-numbered months)
- {偶数|ぐうすう}{日|び} (even-numbered days)
- License plate restrictions (odd/even day driving)
